name: tripsurance-be
description: A modern Node.js Starter with Express, TypeScript, and ESM

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json --resolve-full-paths && npm run copy-assets

scripts-info.start: Runs the compiled application in production mode using environment variables.
scripts-info.dev: Starts the development server with hot-reload (tsx) and development environment.
scripts-info.fix: Automatically fixes linting issues and formats code with Prettier.
scripts-info.clean: Removes the dist directory for a fresh build.
scripts-info.build: Compiles TypeScript to JavaScript and resolves path aliases.
scripts-info.copy-assets: Copies the OpenAPI YAML spec tree into dist/ (not handled by tsc).
scripts-info.test:watch: Runs the test suite in watch mode (Vitest).
scripts-info.db:migrate: Creates and applies a new migration in development (prompts for a migration name).
scripts-info.db:deploy: Applies existing migrations without prompts (CI/production deploy).
scripts-info.db:push: Pushes schema changes to the DB directly without creating a migration (prototyping only).
scripts-info.db:studio: Opens Prisma Studio, a local GUI for browsing and editing DB data.
scripts-info.db:reset: Drops the DB, re-applies all migrations from scratch, and re-runs the seed.
scripts-info.db:seed: Runs prisma/seed.ts to insert baseline test data (e.g. login test accounts).

author: Dryst
